278284694.description:
Carved Meerschaum Pipe Lot
Horse and Sultan Head Designs
Vintage, Set of 2 With Cases
This lot features two intricately hand-carved pipes crafted from white meerschaum, a porous mineral prized for its heat resistance and ability to color over time with use. One pipe showcases a detailed horse head, while the other depicts a bearded figure in the traditional Sultan style. These pieces represent a classic era of pipe artistry, characterized by fine decorative carving and custom-fitted protective cases.
Pipe 1: Detailed horse head bowl carving with yellow amber-colored stem and orange-lined case
Pipe 2: Sultan head bowl carving with orange marbled amber-style stem and white-lined case
Material: Hand-carved white meerschaum with synthetic resin stems
Protective hard-shell cases included for both pieces, featuring hinged metal clasps
Condition:
Bowls show surface darkening and charring consistent with previous use. Carvings remain sharp with no significant chips or missing details. Stems are intact with light tooth marks near the mouthpieces. Cases show exterior scuffing and interior fabric wear; clasps are functional. One case includes a small paper fragment.
Thank you for all of your support!
